changes.title: Oak treehouse
items: The treehouse is a great old oak now, north-west of the dancefloor: six rooms up its trunk, from the Dining Room to the Turret, and a pair of rooms off each of the lower four
Its floor is one shape of the tree's own wood: walk from your bed down the trunk to the Terrace and step off its open south-east rim to fly
No more curtains to wait for in the morning: the bedroom door opens as soon as you're dressed
The cloak pegs hang in the Cloakroom now, by the hats

changes.title: Oak crown
items: The treehouse is under one great oak's crown: thick and thin clumps, its limbs showing through, the Terrace and the dancefloor open to the sky
Indoors the crown clears over the room you're in, following its shape
The oak is strung with colourful lights that come on when the party starts and go out when it ends
From far off you can see the great oak standing on the horizon, its lights twinkling, when it lies to the north

changes.title: Hats floor visible
items: The hats lying on the treehouse's hats' floor show again: the rug no longer covers them, and its label sits above them
